items.title: More Than 700,000 Russian Soldiers Killed In Ukraine War, New Analysis Finds
items.description: More than 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed during the nearly-five-year-old war on Ukraine, according to a new analysis, a staggering figure that highlights Moscow's intent on conquering Ukrainian territory -- and Ukraine's intent on inflicting mass casualties.

items.title: Gaza war has undone 77 years of human development, UN warns
items.description: The UN deputy chief urged renewed international support for a two-State solution to the Israel-Palestine conflict on Monday, warning that Palestinians continue to face violence, displacement and dire living conditions despite the October 2025 ceasefire in Gaza.
